lines.zh: 我一步一步往前走，关节卡着响。
lines.en: I walk step by step, joints grinding.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，又重重放下。
lines.en: I lift a leg and set it down heavily.

lines.zh: 我的步子不平，一头偏一头低。
lines.en: My gait is uneven, one side sagging.
I walk out of the rubble.
My path runs crooked.
I walk dragging half a hand.

lines.zh: 我停下来，机件响了一声。
lines.en: I stop and a part clanks.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进碎石里半寸。
lines.en: My foot sinks half a span into the rubble.
Dust falls off me with each step.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我叫人害怕。
lines.en: I am not quick, but I am unsettling.
I sway as I lift a foot.
I step around the broken bricks.

lines.zh: 我站在废墟里，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the ruins without moving.
One of my eye sockets is dark.

lines.zh: 我在等一个没完成的命令。
lines.en: I am waiting on an unfinished order.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看裂开的掌。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at the split palm.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有东西在转。
lines.en: Something turns inside my body.

lines.zh: 我的指节还保持着握的姿势。
lines.en: My knuckles still hold the shape of a grip.
This used to be a gate.

lines.zh: 我记得守门的每一个步骤。
lines.en: I still remember every step of guarding a gate.
Another part clanks.
This square is empty of people.
One of my legs is half a length short.
I rest a hand on the broken pillar.
The wind through the gate passes here.
I turn my head to you, crooked.
You have stepped inside the gate.
I cannot lift my head very far.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，辨认你的轮廓。
lines.en: I tilt my head to make out your outline.

lines.zh: 你身上有活的东西的味道。
lines.en: You smell of something alive.
My head has dropped again.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了一下，又暗了。
lines.en: My eye lights once, then dims.
You are standing inside the gate.
I am not sure what I should do.
I give half a step and dust falls.
A fragment of me falls away.
That landed on the crack.
A wisp of black mist leaks from my crack.
I raise a hand to shield.
I am still moving, little by little.
Dust leaks from the seams.

lines.zh: 我不知道该退还是该进。
lines.en: I do not know whether to retreat or advance.

lines.zh: 你把面包举给我，我没有胃。
lines.en: You hold out bread, but I have no stomach.
That is not in the order.
I turned my crooked head aside.

lines.zh: 我的手上没有能拿它的地方。
lines.en: My hands have nowhere to hold it.
I withdrew a distance.
That has nothing to do with me.
I spared it one glance.
I stay fixed where I am.
You keep it yourself.

lines.zh: 一块碎石从我肋间滑落。
lines.en: A chunk of rubble slips from between my ribs.
A piece of me falls off.
I cannot raise a hand to block.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖发出石头相磨的声。
lines.en: My knee grinds stone against stone.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我裂开的地方。
lines.en: That struck where I am cracked.
I slowly right myself.
My hand rose and fell again.
Dust has come down all over the floor.

lines.zh: 我连自己是什么都不清楚。
lines.en: I am not even sure what I am.
I shake my head, slowly.
I cannot raise my hand.
This body is broken.

lines.zh: 门轴响了一下，没有别的。
lines.en: The hinge creaked; nothing else.
That gate still stands open.
I turn, and my parts grind.
I do not remember such things.
I walk deeper into the ruins.
I reach, but my hand will not close.
It slides out of my grip.
I pressed it down with my palm.
I cannot identify this.
I stared at it a long while.
I pushed it over to you.
It weighs almost nothing.
One squeeze and it broke.
I set it on the broken pillar.
I have no use for it.
I raise my head and my neck grinds.
Is there an order, or is there not?
I raise a hand and stop halfway.
My eye has not left you.

lines.zh: 命令的碎片在我脑中拼起来。
lines.en: Fragments of an order click together in my head.
Something has come back to me.
This gate needs a keeper.
I am unsure whether to fight.
My other hand came up too.
I have taken the first step.
I take this step heavily.
Dust falls from my joints.
You are standing in the gateway.

lines.zh: 我抬手护住自己裂开的胸口。
lines.en: I raise an arm over my split chest.

lines.zh: 我的断臂在墙边刮出声。
lines.en: My broken arm scrapes along the wall.
My pace has not changed.
I raise a hand and drop it again.
I fill the doorway.

lines.zh: 我在等一个明确的命令。
lines.en: I am waiting for a clear order.
You retreat, and I still advance.
I cannot go around, so I go straight.
I leave a path in the dust.
A joint grinds again.
You are between the gate and the wall.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己为什么追。
lines.en: I do not know why I follow.
That step came quickly.
I ram you with my shoulder.
That struck the ground.

lines.zh: 我整条前臂砸在你背上。
lines.en: I bring my whole forearm down on your back.
I shove with my broken hand.

lines.zh: 这一下甩出去，我自己也晃。
lines.en: That swing rocked me too.
I lifted my hand once more.
That blow landed on nothing.
My joints are grinding hard.
That was not accurate, but it was heavy.
I stopped once before moving.
I have started to move again.

lines.zh: 废墟里有一块站了起来。
lines.en: A piece of the ruins stands up.
My fingers move first.
Stones roll away, and I am there.
This gate has a guard again.
Dust spreads around me.
I raise one eye to look.

lines.zh: 我站在断裂的柱子旁边。
lines.en: I stand beside the broken pillar.
The cracks in me keep creaking.
I test my feet.
It is too quiet here.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己醒了多久。
lines.en: I do not know how long I have been awake.

lines.zh: 我先看了看门还在不在。
lines.en: I check first whether the gate still stands.

lines.zh: 火烤着我裂开的壳，我不躲。
lines.en: Fire bakes my cracked shell; I do not dodge.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，再也没那么快站起来。
lines.en: I fall, and I do not rise as quickly again.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的缝隙，机件卡住了。
lines.en: Water enters my seams and my parts seize.
The blast blows a corner off me.

lines.zh: 一股力把我定住，我挣不开。
lines.en: Some force holds me and I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 我体内那个东西快停了。
lines.en: The thing inside me is nearly still.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我闪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I flicker.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我的重量也没有用。
lines.en: The ground is gone and my weight is useless.
